rows: Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear.
Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night.
Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.
Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.
Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind.
Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness.
Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it.
You may freely eat of every tree of the garden.
It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.
This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.
“Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?”
Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?
We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden.
I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.
Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?
“The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.”
The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.
“The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.”
Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field.
I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain.
Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil.
I have gotten a man with Yahweh’s help.
Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?
What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.
“My punishment is greater than I can bear.”
My punishment is greater than I can bear.
Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.
Adah and Zillah, hear my voice.
for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.
This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which Yahweh has cursed.
My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.
I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.
Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.
Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.
I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth.
Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.
Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.
Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.
Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.
Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do.
Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.
I will give this land to your offspring.
See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.
What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?
Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.
Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward.
Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.
Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.
I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.
Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.
Lord Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?
Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.
This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.
Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.
I am Yahweh who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.
Lord Yahweh, how will I know that I will inherit it?
Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them.
I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates.
See now, Yahweh has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.
This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me.
Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.
You are a God who sees.
Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?
Oh that Ishmael might live before you!
No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac.
My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.
Very well, do as you have said.
Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.
I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.
After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?

Will I hide from Abraham what I do.
Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous.
Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?

I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.
What if there are forty found there?
Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?
See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?
Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?
Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.
Do you have anybody else here?
Get up! Get out of this place, for Yahweh will destroy the city!
Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.
Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!
Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.

Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let’s make him drink wine again tonight.
Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man’s wife.
Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?
Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me.
What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin?
What did you see, that you have done this thing?
Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’
Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.
Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver.
God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.

Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant.
Don’t let me see the death of the child.
God is with you in all that you do.
I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.
What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?

Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah.

God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.

I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you.

No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it.

Please put your hand under my thigh.

Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.
Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.
I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.

I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.
We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.
Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master.
Come in, you blessed of Yahweh. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
I will not eat until I have told my message.
The thing proceeds from Yahweh. We can’t speak to you bad or good.
Send me away to my master.
Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.
Don’t hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.
We will call the young lady, and ask her.
Will you go with this man?
Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them.
Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?
If it is like this, why do I live?
Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people.

Don’t go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about.
Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?

He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.
Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.
For now Yahweh has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.

We saw plainly that Yahweh was with you.
See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.

How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?

The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
Are you really my son Esau?
Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.
Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

Bless me, even me also, my father.

Do you have just one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.
Behold, your dwelling will be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of the sky from above.

Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.
I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth.
You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.
If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on.
My relatives, where are you from?
Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?

Surely you are my bone and my flesh.

It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.

Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.
Because Yahweh has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.
Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.
This time I will praise Yahweh.
Give me children, or else I will die.
Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?
Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.
God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.
I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.
Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.
Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.

You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.
God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.

God has taken away my reproach.
May Yahweh add another son to me.
Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.
If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that Yahweh has blessed me for your sake.
Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.
You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.
Behold, let it be according to your word.
Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.
Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.

Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.

Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.

The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine!
This heap is witness between me and you today.
Yahweh watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.
See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.

I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.
Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.
Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.
Get me this young lady as a wife.

These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it.

Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there.
Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.

Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.

This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.

Do this, and live, for I fear God.
